d2_answers.question: Separate organic growth from acquisition/consolidation effects.
d2_answers.fact: The prior semantic work already established that reported growth mixes Salt City ramp and same-control consolidation. The refreshed primary set contains financing and fundraising disclosures but does not provide a new entity-level pro-forma bridge that isolates organic growth.
d2_answers.interpretation: Direction remains positive but exact organic growth is still not independently reconstructable from the refreshed set.

d2_answers.question: Model utilization, pricing, incremental margins and ROIC for new testing capacity.
d2_answers.fact: The 2026-08-17 CNINFO discovery now returns 20 primary disclosures, including the convertible-bond feasibility report, listing documents, fundraising substitution/child-company funding notices and idle-proceeds cash-management notices. None of the discovered primary disclosures provides project-level realized utilization, realized price/mix, incremental EBITDA or a mature ROIC series for the Salt City proving ground or the new ice/snow base.
d2_answers.interpretation: Financing completion improves evidence on funding availability but does not answer the decisive capital-efficiency question. Idle-proceeds cash management also indicates part of the raised capital had not yet been deployed at the disclosure date, which is not evidence of operating utilization.

d2_answers.question: Assess convertible-bond dilution and balance-sheet implications.
d2_answers.fact: Primary CNINFO bond disclosures confirm a RMB1.03904bn convertible-bond issue and RMB5.99 initial conversion price. The refreshed set also confirms fundraising-account governance and cash-management actions after issuance.
d2_answers.interpretation: Funding runway is improved, but the prior dilution and capital-intensity concerns remain unchanged; the new evidence does not demonstrate earnings accretion sufficient to offset potential dilution.

d2_answers.question: Map competitive moat and customer concentration.
d2_answers.fact: No refreshed primary disclosure in the current set supersedes the R1 evidence on proving-ground network advantages or 2025 customer concentration. The 2025 H1 investor-relations materials continue to support the strategic case for smart-connected and extreme-climate testing demand.
d2_answers.interpretation: Infrastructure/scenario coverage remains the principal moat; customer and related-party concentration remain active risk gates.

d2_answers.question: Define valuation ceiling and utilization/ROIC kill conditions.
d2_answers.assumption: Retain the R1 analytical ceiling framework until mature project economics are disclosed; do not raise the ceiling merely because financing has closed.
d2_answers.judgment: HOLD. Kill conditions remain: prolonged under-utilization, mature after-tax project return below the 8-10% research hurdle, rising customer concentration with weaker third-party demand, or dilution without proportionate earnings accretion. None can be formally cleared from the refreshed evidence.

evidence_gap.missing: Project-level realized utilization, realized pricing/mix, incremental margin and mature return series sufficient to underwrite Salt City and the new ice/snow base.
